summary: Aurelion Inc. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US analogue of a US Form 8-K) announcing the appointment of Ms. Joyce Zheng as Chief Accounting Officer effective September 14, 2026, replacing acting CAO Ms. Yuki Xu. The disclosure recites Ms. Zheng's background, including ten-plus years in corporate finance and audit, a Financial Controller role at Antalpha, and prior Ernst & Young service; no terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. This is a routine officer succession, not a special situation.
